baseline.actual: An actual child host worker, loopback upstream and HTTP gateway changed one astral character into two U+FFFD replacement characters at the redaction flush boundary.

scope: Move the outgoing string boundary back by one UTF-16 code unit when it would split a valid surrogate pair.
Keep the existing UTF-8 streaming decoder and secret-redaction lookbehind; no SDK, tool, budget, deadline or patient-flow change.
Actual HTTP checks compare complete received text, a four-byte UTF-8 character split across upstream chunks, and a synthetic credential split across chunks alongside Unicode.
Each gateway case checks one actual loopback provider request and one counted model call; the configured synthetic provider credential is supplied upstream and absent from the forwarded text.
boundaries: The host worker and HTTP forwarding are real. A test-only Node loader substitutes the SDK client with a double; no real SDK process, command execution, agent reasoning or filesystem isolation is exercised by these three tests.
Tests use synthetic stream fragments and credentials, not external model calls or patient data.
These checks do not prove arbitrary transport compatibility or measure model task quality.
Browser and native GUI suites were not rerun for this transport-only change. Existing layout acceptance remains attached to its earlier tested commits.

windows.required: Three actual-host gateway transport cases on both native matrices, plus existing full SDK, GUI and installation acceptance.
